title: Tokyo Village Salad
description: A Japanese twist on the classic salad, featuring fresh tomatoes and crunchy cucumbers, inspired by the flavors of Tokyo's village markets.

ingredients.name: village salad mix
ingredients.notes: including lettuce, carrots, and other vegetables

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the village salad mix and sliced cucumbers.
Cut the tomatoes into wedges and add them to the bowl.
Drizzle the traditional greek salad dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
